title: "Trade Policy Activity Index"
page-layout: full
toc: false
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| results: 'asis'

library(jsonlite)

df <- read.csv("data/tpa_main.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
df$date <- as.Date(paste0("01 ", df$Date), format = "%d %b %Y")
df <- df[order(df$date), ]
names(df) <- gsub("_filtered_normalized", "", names(df))
names(df)[names(df) == "Global_Factor"]    <- "Global"
names(df)[names(df) == "Remaining_others"] <- "Remaining_Other"

series_meta <- list(
  list(id="Global",          label="Global TPA Index",                  color="#004C97"),
  list(id="Facilitating",    label="Facilitating measures",              color="#2E8B57"),
  list(id="Other",           label="Other (non-facilitating)",           color="#C8922A"),
  list(id="Restrictive",     label="Restrictive (subset of Other)",      color="#C0392B"),
  list(id="Remaining_Other", label="Remaining other (subset of Other)",  color="#7B4F9E"),
  list(id="G20",             label="G20 economies",                      color="#0071BC"),
  list(id="Non_G20",         label="Non-G20 economies",                  color="#E67E22"),
  list(id="GDP_weighted",    label="GDP-weighted index",                  color="#8B6914")
)

for (i in seq_along(series_meta)) {
  series_meta[[i]]$values <- as.numeric(df[[ series_meta[[i]]$id ]])
}

payload <- list(dates = format(df$date, "%Y-%m-%d"), series = series_meta)
cat('<script>var TPA_DATA =', toJSON(payload, auto_unbox=TRUE, na="null"), ';</script>\n')
```

<!-- ═══ ABOUT ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<section id="about" class="page-section">
  <div class="site-container">
    <h2 class="section-heading">About the TPA Index</h2>

    <p class="about-lead">
      The Trade Policy Activity (TPA) Index is a composite indicator of global trade policy
      activity, constructed using a Dynamic Factor Model applied to comprehensive data on
      trade policy interventions across 197 countries and territories since January 2010.
      The index documents a structural shift around 2019, reflecting a substantial and
      persistent expansion in the use of trade policy measures globally.
    </p>

    <div class="two-col-grid">
      <div class="two-col-item">
        <h3>How has it been constructed?</h3>
        <p>
          The TPA Index is estimated using a Dynamic Factor Model (DFM) on a large
          cross-section of monthly trade policy intervention data sourced from the
          Global Trade Alert (GTA) and WTO databases. The model extracts a common
          factor from the co-movement across country- and measure-level series,
          interpreted as aggregate global trade policy activity. All series are
          smoothed using a three-month moving average and normalized so that the
          average equals zero over January 2010–December 2011. The index additionally
          incorporates Mixed Data Sampling (MIDAS) regressions on high-frequency GTA
          data to enable real-time nowcasting of trade policy shifts.
        </p>
      </div>
      <div class="two-col-item">
        <h3>What does it include?</h3>
        <p>
          The dataset provides eight monthly series from January 2010 to October 2025:
          a <strong>Global Factor</strong> (baseline worldwide index);
          a <strong>Facilitating</strong> sub-index (trade-liberalizing measures and rollbacks);
          an <strong>Other</strong> sub-index (non-facilitating measures including tariff
          increases, bans, quotas, and subsidies);
          a <strong>Restrictive</strong> sub-index (trade-restricting subset of Other);
          a <strong>Remaining other</strong> sub-index (largely subsidies and industrial policy);
          <strong>G20</strong> and <strong>Non-G20</strong> economy indices;
          and a <strong>GDP-weighted</strong> index using pre-sample GDP shares (2005–2009)
          as time-invariant weights.
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="two-col-grid">
      <div class="two-col-item">
        <h3>Why is it different from other measures?</h3>
        <p>
          Existing trade policy measures tend to focus on tariffs alone or rely on
          annual survey data. The TPA Index covers the full range of policy instruments —
          tariffs, non-tariff barriers, export restrictions, and industrial policy — at
          monthly frequency across a near-global sample. Its DFM framework extracts the
          underlying co-movement rather than simply counting interventions, and the MIDAS
          nowcasting component enables real-time monitoring well ahead of official data releases.
        </p>
      </div>
      <div class="two-col-item">
        <h3>What are the key findings?</h3>
        <p>
          The TPA Index identifies a structural break around 2019 — a persistent expansion
          in global trade policy activity departing from the post-GFC baseline. Beyond this
          trend, the index captures cyclical spikes during the 2018–19 US–China trade war,
          COVID-19 supply chain disruptions, and the post-2022 wave of industrial policy.
          G20 and non-G20 economies differ significantly in the timing, intensity, and
          instrument mix of their trade policy responses.
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ═══ CHART JAVASCRIPT ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  function buildPicker() {
    var picker = document.getElementById('series-picker');
    if (!picker) return;
    picker.innerHTML = '';
    TPA_DATA.series.forEach(function (s, i) {
      var lbl    = document.createElement('label');
      var cb     = document.createElement('input');
      cb.type    = 'checkbox';
      cb.id      = 'cb-' + s.id;
      cb.checked = (i === 0);
      cb.addEventListener('change', tpaUpdate);

      // Filled rectangle swatch (not a line)
      var swatch = document.createElement('span');
      swatch.className        = 'swatch';
      swatch.style.background = s.color;

      lbl.appendChild(cb);
      lbl.appendChild(swatch);
      lbl.appendChild(document.createTextNode('\u00a0' + s.label));
      picker.appendChild(lbl);
    });
  }

  window.tpaUpdate = function () {
    var yrStart = parseInt(document.getElementById('yr-start').value, 10) || 2010;
    var yrEnd   = parseInt(document.getElementById('yr-end').value,   10) || 2025;

    var dates    = TPA_DATA.dates;
    var mask     = dates.map(function (d) {
      var y = parseInt(d.slice(0, 4), 10);
      return y >= yrStart && y <= yrEnd;
    });
    var filtDates = dates.filter(function (_, i) { return mask[i]; });

    var traces = [];
    TPA_DATA.series.forEach(function (s) {
      var cb = document.getElementById('cb-' + s.id);
      if (!cb || !cb.checked) return;
      var vals = s.values.filter(function (_, i) { return mask[i]; });
      traces.push({
        x:    filtDates,
        y:    vals,
        type: 'scatter',
        mode: 'lines',
        name: s.label,
        line: { color: s.color, width: 2.5 },
        hovertemplate: '<b>%{x|%b %Y}</b>: %{y:.1f}<extra>' + s.label + '</extra>'
      });
    });

    var layout = {
      shapes: [
        { type: 'line', xref: 'x', yref: 'paper',
          x0: '2019-01-01', x1: '2019-01-01', y0: 0, y1: 1,
          line: { color: '#C8922A', width: 1.6, dash: 'dot' } },
        { type: 'rect', xref: 'x', yref: 'paper',
          x0: '2020-03-01', x1: '2021-03-01', y0: 0, y1: 1,
          fillcolor: 'rgba(200,146,42,0.07)', line: { width: 0 } }
      ],
      annotations: [{
        xref: 'x', yref: 'paper',
        x: '2019-03-01', y: 0.97,
        text: 'Structural break ~2019',
        showarrow: false, xanchor: 'left',
        font: { size: 13, color: '#C8922A', family: 'Georgia,serif' }
      }],
      xaxis: {
        type: 'date',
        tickfont:  { size: 14, color: '#333', family: 'Georgia,serif' },
        showgrid:  false, zeroline: false, title: ''
      },
      yaxis: {
        title: { text: 'TPA Index', font: { size: 14, color: '#333', family: 'Georgia,serif' } },
        tickfont:  { size: 14, color: '#333', family: 'Georgia,serif' },
        gridcolor: '#e8e8e8',
        zeroline: true, zerolinecolor: '#bbbbbb', zerolinewidth: 1
      },
      legend: {
        orientation: 'h',
        x: 0, xanchor: 'left',
        y: -0.22, yanchor: 'top',
        font: { size: 13, family: 'Georgia,serif' },
        bgcolor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0)',
        // Use filled squares in legend (not lines)
        itemsizing: 'constant'
      },
      showlegend:    true,
      paper_bgcolor: 'white',
      plot_bgcolor:  'white',
      font:          { family: 'Georgia,serif' },
      margin:        { l: 75, r: 25, t: 30, b: 160 },
      hovermode:     'x unified'
    };

    var config = {
      responsive: true,
      displayModeBar: true,
      modeBarButtonsToRemove: ['zoom2d','pan2d','select2d','lasso2d',
                                'autoScale2d','toggleSpikelines'],
      displaylogo: false,
      toImageButtonOptions: {
        format: 'png', filename: 'tpa_index', width: 1300, height: 600
      }
    };

    if (traces.length === 0) {
      Plotly.purge('tpa-chart-out');
    } else {
      Plotly.react('tpa-chart-out', traces, layout, config);
    }
  };

  function init() {
    buildPicker();
    tpaUpdate();
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();
</script>
